Just verified numbers, so you know exactly what you're eating.

settings.heading: Factory farms pollute. Seatopia farms protect.

settings.text: You hear it everywhere, “I only eat wild caught fish.” However, “If current trends continue, we will see virtually all fish stocks collapse by the year 2048.” — Dr. Boris Worm, Marine Biologist, Dalhousie University.
